name: RC-B10-0070/2026 – Recital T
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the attempted takeover of Lithuania’s public broadcaster and the threat to democracy in Lithuania
part_text: whereas in the context of the ongoing legislative initiatives affecting LRT’s governance, LRT was criticised for using airtime and resources for journalists’ protest actions in defence of freedom of expression, including the broadcasting of minutes of silence; whereas such statements risk contributing to political pressure and may have a discouraging effect on editorial independence;
